assessment.expectedSupplyBoundary: This single-port path has a model restart window. The most recent comparable R132 cutover measured 23.095 seconds; R133 has not been switched, so its actual window is unknown.
assessment.minimumNextStep: Provision and validate continuous same-US supply first: either a separate warm worker, or a reviewed proxy and dual-model-port design with peak GPU safety proven alongside Clone and Nari. Validate real audio, concurrency, health, drain and rollback through the intended route before an explicit reviewed cutover.
assessment.reason: The validated CPU candidate is stopped and not capacity-tested, and the fixed public Kokoro mapping reaches only internal port 8880. Existing GPU jobs use about 13.9 GiB; loading a second Kokoro may fit nominal free VRAM but simultaneous peak safety was not validated.
assessment.zeroGapRequiresAdditionalWork: Provision and validate a separate same-US warm worker or introduce a reviewed local proxy/model-port architecture, then CAS both public gateways to it. Neither exists today.
